name: Mini Racer Online
summary: Mini Racer Online — a top-down multiplayer racing game you play right in your browser! Battle other drivers in real time across all kinds of tracks, climb the leaderboard and fully customize your ride: colors, neons, rims, trails, horns, exclusive badges… Join the Creator Cups, ranked seasons, and race against the ghosts of the best. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.
